description:
READ-ONLY (rolled back): for each LOGIN (real users - give the ones whose roles matter:
    salespeople, warehouse, accounting, HR, portal), what they see in the SOURCE-version reference
    vs the migrated target: REACHABLE menus (every ancestor visible) that exist in BOTH versions,
    read/create/write rights on business models and how many records they see. A user who sees a
    larger SHARE of the records in the target is flagged as possible access widening (Odoo 20 adds
    up the access of all groups); counts that differ for everyone alike are `data_differences`,
    menus of one version only are counted in `structural`. Each difference is a decision to make
    (options.menu_groups) or a compatibility rule to add - nothing is changed here.
name: data_pump_parity
